provenance.title: Combinatorial optimization in geometry
provenance.authors: Igor Rivin Mathematics Institute, Warwick University

disposition: proposals only — promote via document-intake Stage 4; nothing here is folio content and nothing here creates Lean

candidates.statement: It was observed in [@rivid; @rvol] that this was a special case of the problem of characterizing the *Delaunay tessellations* of singular Euclidean surfaces -- there is a canonical way to associate ideal polyhedra to Delaunay triangulations of a convex flat disk with convex polygonal boundary.
candidates.formalization_note: Science claim (empirical-measurement, evidence: in-paper — In-paper empirical measurement in sections/sec-000-introduction.md (p. 1-3)). Empirical/numerical values are routed to compute-check for witness comparison, never wired as formal axioms.
